title: Dealing: Or the Berkeley-to-Boston Forty-Brick Lost-Bag Blues
writer: Douglas Crichton, Michael Crichton, David Odell
actors: Howard Gardner, Robert F. Lyons, Ellen Barber
plot: A cocky Harvard graduate transports a load of marijuana from Berkeley to Boston. His girlfriend gets busted with the second load. He and a friend go against a dirty cop and a Cuban gangster to get the load and the girl back.
